name: Vanquish the Betrayers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
narrative.offerRewardText: Word of your bravery travels fast, Champion. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
narrative.requestItemsText:
You have your orders, adventurer. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.

Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 7 to 8, 1,325 XP in all.
